title: FEVER: a Large-scale Dataset for Fact Extraction and VERification
authors_zh: James Thorne 等（University of Sheffield, Amazon）
best_for_zh: 需要补齐基础 benchmark 坐标、评测契约、contamination 和 scorer 审计的读者。
one_line: FEVER links 185,445 factual claims to Wikipedia evidence and labels, making fact verification an evidence-grounded evaluation task.
FEVER 把 185,445 条 factual claims 绑定到 Wikipedia 证据句和三分类标签，是证据约束 fact verification 的经典 benchmark。
why: It supplies a reusable evaluation coordinate for fact-verification, evidence-retrieval work.
inclusion_reason: FEVER links 185,445 factual claims to Wikipedia evidence and labels, making fact verification an evidence-grounded evaluation task.

title: Problem
问题
html: FEVER asks how to evaluate fact verification as claim labeling with retrieved textual evidence. The primary sources are the NAACL-HLT 2018 ACL Anthology paper, arXiv:1803.05355, the FEVER dataset page, and the official scorer. It belongs here as an evidence-grounded fact-verification benchmark, not as a free-form generation or RAG benchmark. A record contains a Wikipedia-derived claim, a label among SUPPORTS, REFUTES, and NOT ENOUGH INFO, and evidence sentence sets for supported/refuted claims. Its atlas value is the explicit coupling of answer label and evidence retrieval in the scoring contract.

FEVER 关注的问题是：如何把事实验证评测成带文本证据的 claim labeling。主要来源是 NAACL-HLT 2018 ACL Anthology 论文、arXiv:1803.05355、FEVER 数据页和官方 scorer。这里收录它是因为它是 evidence-grounded fact-verification benchmark，而不是自由生成或 RAG benchmark。一个记录包含 Wikipedia 派生 claim、SUPPORTS/REFUTES/NOT ENOUGH INFO 标签，以及 supported/refuted claim 的证据句集合。它对 atlas 的价值是把答案标签和 evidence retrieval 显式绑定到评分契约中。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a large benchmark of 185,445 human-annotated claims derived from Wikipedia, with labels and evidence requirements. The mechanism edits or constructs claims from Wikipedia, annotates veracity, and requires systems to retrieve evidence for supported/refuted labels. The feedback contract combines label accuracy with evidence correctness through the FEVER score. Closest comparisons are recognizing textual entailment datasets, fact-checking corpora, and later claim-grounding benchmarks. The direction label is evidence-coupled factual verification.

核心贡献是 185,445 条由 Wikipedia 派生并人工标注的 claims，带标签和证据要求。机制是从 Wikipedia 改写或构造 claim，标注真伪，并要求系统为 supported/refuted 标签检索证据。反馈契约通过 FEVER score 结合 label accuracy 和 evidence correctness。最近对比是文本蕴含数据集、fact-checking corpus 和后来的 claim-grounding benchmark。方向标签是 evidence-coupled factual verification。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Inputs: Wikipedia pages, constructed claims, human labels, and evidence sentence annotations. 2. Pipeline: generate or edit claims, label them as SUPPORTS, REFUTES, or NOT ENOUGH INFO, annotate evidence for verifiable claims, and evaluate systems on label plus evidence. 3. Outputs: train/dev/test/reserved splits, evidence annotations, and scorer outputs. 4. Feedback: FEVER score gives credit when the predicted label is correct and, for supported/refuted claims, sufficient evidence is retrieved among the allowed predictions. 5. Reuse requires pinning dataset release, Wikipedia snapshot assumptions, scorer version, maximum evidence predictions, and split policy.

1. 输入：Wikipedia 页面、构造 claim、人工标签和证据句标注。2. 流程：生成或改写 claim，标注 SUPPORTS/REFUTES/NOT ENOUGH INFO，为可验证 claim 标注证据，并用标签加证据评测系统。3. 输出：train/dev/test/reserved split、证据标注和 scorer 输出。4. 反馈：FEVER score 只有在预测标签正确且 supported/refuted claim 检索到足够证据时给 credit。5. 复用前要固定数据 release、Wikipedia 快照假设、scorer 版本、最大证据预测数和 split policy。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports 185,445 claims with split counts of 145,449 training, 9,999 dev, 9,999 test, and 19,998 reserved claims. The row-level evidence is the gold label plus evidence sentence set; aggregate accuracy alone is insufficient because evidence retrieval is part of the task. NEI claims have no supporting evidence requirement. Evidence is bounded by Wikipedia at construction time, annotation policy, and the official scorer's treatment of evidence sets.

论文报告 185,445 条 claim，split 为 145,449 train、9,999 dev、9,999 test 和 19,998 reserved。逐样本证据是 gold label 加 evidence sentence set；只有汇总 accuracy 不够，因为 evidence retrieval 是任务的一部分。NEI claim 不要求支持证据。证据边界包括构造时的 Wikipedia、标注政策和官方 scorer 对证据集合的处理。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior NLI benchmarks usually gave premise-hypothesis labels without requiring open evidence retrieval. FEVER changes the object to claims over Wikipedia with evidence sentences. The direction signal is that factuality evaluation should measure both answer and provenance. What is not new is entailment classification itself. Before reuse, inspect evidence sufficiency, annotation ambiguity, Wikipedia drift, claim leakage, and whether downstream systems compare on the same scorer and split.

已有 NLI benchmark 通常给 premise-hypothesis 标签，但不要求开放证据检索。FEVER 把对象改成关于 Wikipedia 的 claim，并附证据句。方向信号是 factuality evaluation 应同时测答案和 provenance。蕴含分类本身并不新。复用前要查 evidence sufficiency、标注歧义、Wikipedia 漂移、claim 泄漏，以及下游系统是否使用同一 scorer 和 split。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is tied to the Wikipedia snapshot and annotation choices. Some claims can be ambiguous, under-specified, or affected by later page changes. Evidence sets may not include every valid sentence combination, and strict scoring can reject semantically valid alternatives. FEVER should not be treated as a live fact-checking environment or as proof that a system can verify arbitrary real-world claims.
正确性绑定于 Wikipedia 快照和标注选择。部分 claim 可能歧义、信息不足，或受后续页面变化影响。证据集合不一定包含所有有效句子组合，严格评分可能拒绝语义有效替代证据。FEVER 不应被当成 live fact-checking 环境，也不能证明系统能验证任意现实世界 claim。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use FEVER as a schema for evidence-grounded verification. Preserve claim id, label, evidence pages and sentence ids, predicted label, predicted evidence, scorer version, and split. It is useful for auditing whether a factuality system can supply provenance, not just a yes/no label.
可把 FEVER 用作 evidence-grounded verification schema。复用时保留 claim id、label、evidence page/sentence id、预测标签、预测证据、scorer 版本和 split。它适合审计 factuality 系统是否能提供 provenance，而不只是 yes/no 标签。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Do not compare FEVER accuracy and FEVER score as if they are the same metric. Keep label correctness, evidence correctness, and NEI behavior separate. Read the official scorer before interpreting leaderboard numbers.
不要把 FEVER accuracy 和 FEVER score 当成同一个指标。要分开 label correctness、evidence correctness 和 NEI 行为。解读排行榜前先读官方 scorer。
